test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

A man may die, nations may rise and fall, but an idea __**lived on.**__
solution:
"The correct answer is **option 4, "lives on."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb **"live"** needs to agree with the subject** "an idea,"** which is singular. Also, the given sentence is a** general truth.**
 
• Thus, it will be expressed in **simple present tense.**
 
• Therefore, the correct form of the verb is **"lives."**
 
• However, the sentence also requires a preposition to show how the idea continues to exist.
 
• The correct preposition in this case is** "on," **which means **"to continue to exist or be active."**
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase is **"lives on."**
 
• **Option 1, "lives in,"** is incorrect because it does not convey the same meaning as the original sentence.
 
• **Option 2, "live on,"** is grammatically incorrect because it is missing the necessary subject-verb agreement.
 
• **Option 3, "No improvement,"** is incorrect.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *A man may die, nations may rise and fall, but an idea __**lives on**__.*
